title: Genuine payment to a new payee during a long call from an unknown number
story: Her grandson's college accounts office calls from a new landline for 55 minutes to sort out a fee mismatch, and she pays ₹18,000 to the college account.
why: This looks just like a digital arrest (60+, 23× usual, long unknown call). A pause or trusted check is acceptable; the payee is clean, so a hold would be a false alarm we must not make.
